name: sparx — Artist Media
tagline: A stage-dark artist-site template for a band that releases, tours and sells.
description: A media-forward, stage-dark site for a recording artist or band — a poster-scale artist hero, a latest-release feature with streaming links, a tour-dates run, a live journal, and a bespoke article page, in a near-black theme with a vivid magenta accent. Modelled on the recording-artist archetype; shipped as Vela. Ships a light music + merch store (vinyl, a tee, a hoodie, a digital album) to demonstrate content + commerce together.
